name: Meguri Ai
source:
Hero won a luxury cruise ship two weeks tour. He gets to know that his first love Moriyama Yui who he promised to marry also goes on the same trip. Whether to ignite his old feelings or enjoy new acquaintances is up to him to decide.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄赢得了豪华游轮为期两周的旅行。他得知他答应结婚的初恋情人森山由衣也参加了同一次旅行。是重燃旧情还是享受新相识，由他自己决定。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
